title: Why Ice Changes Everything
subtitle: The most overlooked part of your drink is doing the most work.
summary: Understanding how ice affects dilution, temperature, and balance is one of the fastest ways to improve your cocktails.

sections.title: It’s Not Just About Cold
sections.body: Ice doesn’t just chill your drink—it controls dilution. And dilution is what brings a cocktail into balance. Too fast and the drink falls apart. Too slow and it never opens up.

sections.title: Size Changes Everything
sections.body: Large cubes melt slower, which makes them ideal for drinks like the Old Fashioned. Smaller ice increases surface area, speeding up dilution when you need it.

sections.title: Clarity and Structure
sections.body: Clear ice isn’t just visual. It melts more predictably and keeps your drink cleaner over time. Cloudy ice tends to break down faster and unevenly.

sections.title: Pay Attention to It
sections.body: If something feels off in your drink, it’s often the ice. Once you start paying attention to it, you’ll notice how much it changes the experience.
